{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']

# Check if QA orders are present
if len(qa_orders) > 0:
    print(f"Found {len(qa_orders)} QA orders. They will be excluded.")
    # Exclude QA orders
    sales_clean = sales[~sales.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]
else:
    print("No QA orders found. Proceeding with full dataset.")
    sales_clean = sales

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Exclude refunded orders from conversion rate calculation
# Only 'completed' orders are valid for conversion rate
valid_orders = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of channel and customer_segment in valid orders
print("Channel distribution in valid orders:")
print(valid_orders['channel'].value_counts())

print("Customer segment distribution in valid orders:")
print(valid_orders['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if the groups are comparable
print("Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(valid_orders['channel'], valid_orders['customer_segment']))

# Calculate conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = valid_orders.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

print(f"Conversion rate (email): {conversion_rates['email']:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {conversion_rates['paid_search']:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")

# Store for final report
conversion_rates, difference"}
